model.name: intervention_set_negative
model.description: Guard fixture (D-negative): a scheduled intervention sets compartment V to a negative value (param neg = -5) at the FINAL step (t = t_end = 5), so there is no subsequent substep whose pre-advance scan could catch it. V appears in no transition rate, so the negative count cannot trigger a negative-propensity error; it sits in the state. On the pre-guard code the run succeeds with V = -5 carried into the final snapshot (genuinely silent). The centralized post-INTERVENE/BALANCE scan rejects it. There is no balance block, so V is not the (exempt) balance target. (Firing mid-run would instead be caught one substep later by the pre-advance scan as the WRONG, per-particle-recoverable BinomialOvershoot cause — which is exactly the hazard this guard removes.)
